description: Godot game: screenshot the running game (window, a node's viewport, or a region) or the editor's 2D/3D view, scaled down. Can save it and diff against a saved image.

compare_to.description: Saved image to diff with (full resolution; changed_rect in viewport px).

node.description: Node to frame (crop to its screen rect), or a viewport.

region.description: Crop, in image px (window px with stretch).

run_id.description: Default: newest run, else the editor's game.

name: godot_game_screenshot
title: Game screenshot
